scope: Public recorded-interface CPML material gradients with scalar/diagonal FP32 maps, periodic or fixed Bloch x/y, z CPML, fixed exterior, soft electric point/z-plane sources, point histories or online collocated spectral planes.
precision: Real FP32 material and gradients. Real FP32 or complex64 fields. Bounded FP64 diagnostic reductions only.

algorithms.trace: Four transverse component planes per step, 16*T*A bytes real or 32*T*A complex
algorithms.observation: Point T*M history, or online B*M samples/seed blocks and F*M spectra
algorithms.asynchronous: Two device chunks, two pinned host chunks, eight reusable events, one copy stream, pageable CPU archive

cpu.group_note: Unique focused cases passed across initial groups and targeted fixture corrections, not a claim of one full-suite run.
cpu.plane_cases: Real Ex/Ey scalar and fixed nonzero Bloch Ex/Ey diagonal, B=1/7, all six fields, two retained noncontiguous complex seeds and fixed exterior zeros.
cpu.diagnostics: Imaginary-only norm and packed reduction blocks limited to 65536 real lanes.
cpu.plane_example: The documented CPU Bloch-diagonal public plane example executed with finite material gradient and output shape [2,12,6].

cuda.point_acceptance: History and CPU archive exactly equal synchronous path. Full admitted VJP and two retained seeds agree with checkpoint reference. Owners release without cycle collection.
cuda.failure_injection: In-flight forward failure drains/closes owned transport. Mid-backward injected compute failure drains reader, releases lock and permits a correct retained retry.
cuda.plane_acceptance: Two frequencies, two 3x4 quadrature planes, six complex fields, full masked material VJP and two retained spectral seeds against checkpointed planes. No T*M observer history.
cuda.memory_scope: Torch allocation increments for tiny correctness fixtures exclude caller inputs and non-Torch context. The real plane case paid cold library allocations, whereas complex followed warm. Do not compare these peaks as an algorithmic advantage.

corrections: Initial transport metadata tests had two expected-value fixture mistakes, corrected without changing runtime.
Public z-plane fixture inherited point-source dimensions and was corrected before computation.
An assertion incorrectly required nonzero derivatives for unexcited normal-incidence polarization components. The corrected physical expectation requires those derivatives to be exactly zero.
A helper singleton test initially violated the minimum Project grid shape and was replaced with a direct local-curl singleton check.
A test-only relative-error helper detached tensors after a harmless scalar-conversion warning. Numerical criteria were unchanged.
limitations: First derivatives only, fixed sources/mesh/monitor and Bloch settings
No full tensor, ADE, general boundary combinations or spatial out-of-core in this API
Plane construction allocates fixed host maps before plan, then counts their allowance in solver admission
Captured compute stream required for async trace consumers
No measured copy/compute overlap, throughput advantage, beyond-VRAM proof or full CR acceptance
No overall FDTDX parity or algorithmic novelty claim
source_hash_scope: Final integration snapshot. Targeted tests preceded final documentation and test-helper cleanup. Final exact-runtime CI is recorded separately in ACCEPTANCE.md.
